profile.headline: 🌟 Senior Full Stack Developer in Oil & Gas Industry | Driving Digital Innovation for Fortune 50 Energy Sector 🌟
profile.summary: Experienced Full Stack Application Developer with a proven track record in the Oil and Gas and Commercial Real Estate industries. My expertise spans server-side technologies, including Web API with ASP.NET Core (C#), PHP and more. I am equally proficient in client-side technologies such as Angular (version 15+) and React.js. I hold a Master's degree in Computer Science from the University of Houston, underlining my commitment to excellence in software development.

positions.title: Sr Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Skills: .NET Framework · Redis · Angular 15 · Java · Apache Kafka · Application Development · Spring Boot · Event-driven

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Application Develper
positions.description:
Customer Portal:

Customer Portal for Marketing, Supply, and Logistics, allowing easy online access to invoices, contracts, bill of landings, and market info. We later expanded its reach to Gathering & Processing customers, enabling them to track meter data like flow rate, volume, and pressure, providing a one-stop solution for our partners.

Resource Tracking System:

The Resource Tracking System I developed boasts a suite of essential HR functions. It streamlines delegation of authority, offers an organizational chart view, and permits easy editing of DOA levels and cost centers. With features to import, approve resource changes, and sync with Active Directory, it ensures accurate personnel data, efficient workflows, and seamless cross-platform integration.

Timesheet Application:

The Timesheet Application I crafted is tailored for Contractors, enabling them to log project-specific hours effortlessly. This ensures transparent tracking of hours dedicated to individual projects, enhancing accurate project time management and allocation.

TIPS Interface:

I automated the process of transferring measured volumes and analysis data between the FlowCal measurement system and the TIPS system. 

Weather Forecasting app:

I've created a Weather Forecasting app for our field workers. It gives historical and 14-day forecast data for each city and region they work in, helping with planning. The app's user-friendly interface makes accessing weather information easy.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed an automatic framework that allows the user to extract large amount of data and analyze it automatically.

For e.g if we consider uspto.gov, even if we search "google", we get around 21000 patents. Now each patents has detailed information of around 15 pages. If we manually try to extract the data of each patent, it will take years and years to complete it. This framework will allow to extract the data on single button click, and will take around a week or two to extract the data without any errors.

After extracting the data, it allows the user to analyze the extracted data as per his requirements.

We used three different tools for this research: 
1. screen-scraper:  Allows the automatic extraction of data 
2. GATE: Allows to analyze the data
3. Knime: Allows for the workflow automation

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to various web application projects in C# .net with the web development team using 3-tier architecture.

Contributed to various projects by analyzing the data required for the system and preparing the database design as well as web page design by communicating with customers throughout the lifecycle.

Responsibilities includes Requirements Analysis, Database Design and Database Normalization, Coding, Testing.

honors.title: Data Extraction
honors.description: Created a script that can extract data automatically from websites. Extracted data for more than 3500 companies, each company having hundreds of thousands of patents, and each patent with large number of pages.

projects.title: ASP.NET MVC 5 Sports Store Application
projects.description: It is an ASP.NET MVC 5  application which includes a store that host a variety of products of various categories, users can browse the list, add them to their 'shopping cart' and 'checkout'.

projects.title: Attendance Management System
projects.description: Implemented a fully featured web-based application using 3-tier architecture, which manages the attendance of all students’ subject wise, class wise, and based on faculty. Attendance reports are generated subject wise or student wise using pie charts.
